optimizer.synergy: Warp Stream's quicker blink and ultimate haste bring Queen's Garden up more often, then armor and health keep Adele standing in her Thornbush while Thorns empower allies.

items.Warp Stream: First buy: quicker blink to land Imperial Lash roots and more Queen's Garden casts.
items.Stonewall: Second, cuts physical damage so Adele survives diving fighters and carries.
items.Forticus: Shield and size boost while engaging, stacking with Iron Rose damage reduction.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Missing-health regen keeps Adele healthy between fights without backing.
items.Catalytic Drive: Magic armor plus a gold-paying execute basic attack for support farm.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: tenacity and a burst of extra armor for long front-line fights.

optimizer.holes: Almost no damage here, so Adele's lash and vine true damage feel weak if your team can't follow her engages.

optimizer.synergy: Hellfire's many fireballs and Web Lash's root feed Entropy and Noxia procs, while ability haste keeps the Eye and web up for constant Hunger stacks.

items.Entropy: First: every Hellfire fireball adds bonus damage, and haste cycles Web Lash faster.
items.Crescelia: Empowered basic attack after each ability, plus mana regen for spamming Hellfire.
items.Noxia: Mark with Web Lash, then Hellfire or Consume pops a max-health chunk.
items.Tainted Scepter: Cuts enemy healing and adds damage per hit from Hellfire's fireball stream.
items.Oblivion Crown: Big magic power multiplier once the core is done, scaling every fireball.
items.Wraith Leggings: Last: magic penetration and bonus ability damage for late fights.

optimizer.holes: All-in magic damage with no armor means Akeron melts when he dives in for Consume bites.

optimizer.synergy: Damage from Maco Sparkle! and Maco Fly! charges Lifecore's healing wisp, so power items first make every Maco Gift! heal bigger and every poke feed a heal.

items.Lifecore: First: poke with abilities to fire healing wisps at your hurt carry.
items.Noxia: Second: hit with one ability, follow with another for bonus max-health damage.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: scales Maco Gift! heals and Maco Fly!'s shield in one slot.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: more power outside the jungle plus health for frontline leaps.
items.Timewarp: Fifth: faster Maco Gift! and Maco Sparkle! for more heals and stuns.
items.Lunaria: Last: banks your damage into a heal for the lowest-health ally.

optimizer.holes: With no armor at all, Maco dies after leaping into a team with Maco Fly! and the heals stop when he does.

optimizer.synergy: Haste from Orion and Timewarp keeps Hive, Swarm and Mark cycling so Pestilence stays stacked, and every recast feeds Mark's heal before Curse finishes the target.

items.Orion: First: haste plus attack speed so Fetid Dagger keeps Pestilence refreshed.
items.Timewarp: Second: shorter Hive and Swarm cooldowns for more Pestilence stacks per fight.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Third: power and health to survive diving through enemies with Swarm.
items.Tainted Scepter: Fourth: cuts enemy healing and adds damage to every ability hit.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration and bonus ability damage for Curse and Hive.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power, which also grows Pestilence's max-health burn.

optimizer.holes: If enemies stack magical armor early, a haste-first build with late penetration leaves Curse hitting too soft to finish anyone.

optimizer.synergy: Contagion's damage ticks charge Lifecore and Lunaria heals while power grows Contagion's ally heal, so Mourn trades tankiness for a sustain-and-damage support role.

items.Lifecore: First: Contagion and Extract hits charge wisps that heal your weakest ally.
items.Noxia: Second: land Abduct, then Beguile or Contagion for bonus max-health damage.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: boosts Contagion healing and Beguile damage in one slot.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fourth: penetration and bonus ability damage for Abduct and Beguile.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fifth: power plus some health for walking in to channel Beguile.
items.Lunaria: Last: stores fight damage and dumps it as a heal on the weakest ally.

optimizer.holes: Mourn channels Abduct and Beguile while slowed; with zero armor he gets burst mid-channel and the mesmerize never lands.

optimizer.synergy: Hot Pursuit's attack speed stacks onto Deathstalker and Viper shred so Shots Fired triggers often, and the late crit items make each empowered long-range shot hit harder.

items.Deathstalker: First: armor shred and attack speed so Shots Fired comes up fast.
items.Viper: Second: more armor shred and on-hit damage that also boosts Buckshot.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: faster wave clear, lifesteal and bonus damage on isolated targets.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: first crit item, executes low targets your Static Trap rooted.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits once enough crit chance is stacked.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: more attack speed and stacking crit for long fights.

optimizer.holes: Crit arrives only with the fourth item, so until then Murdock leans on items the field rarely buys and his sniper ultimate gets no help.

optimizer.synergy: Serenity and Consecrated Ground damage charge Lifecore and Lunaria heals, Sentinel boosts healing on allies Muriel touches, and power scales Alacrity and Reversal Of Fortune shields.

items.Lifecore: First: Serenity pokes charge wisps, and heal power grows Alacrity's shield.
items.Noxia: Second: stun with charged Serenity, follow with Consecrated Ground for bonus damage.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: scales Reversal Of Fortune's shield and Alacrity in one slot.
items.Lunaria: Fourth: turns Consecrated Ground damage into a heal for the weakest ally.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fifth: more power and a bit of health for staying in fights.
items.Timewarp: Last: cuts Alacrity and Serenity cooldowns for more shields and stuns.

optimizer.holes: Charged Serenity makes Muriel stand still, and with no defensive items a diving assassin kills her while Reversal Of Fortune is down.

optimizer.synergy: Thunk and Crash Bang Boom! scale hard off magical power, so Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown first turn his stun and ultimate into real damage before the heal items.

items.Wraith Leggings: First: penetration and bonus damage make Thunk hurt from lane.
items.Oblivion Crown: Second: multiplies power behind Crash Bang Boom!'s final knock-up hit.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Third: power plus health to survive channeling the drum solo.
items.Lifecore: Fourth: Thunk and ultimate damage fire heals onto your weakest ally.
items.Lunaria: Fifth: stores ultimate damage and pays it back as a heal.
items.Windcaller: Last: shares speed with allies, on top of Song Of My People's speed aura.

optimizer.holes: Narbash channels his ultimate while slowed inside fights; Mosh Pit armor alone won't keep a no-defense build alive through the full solo.

optimizer.synergy: Neural Network turns every third basic ability into an Overclocked cast, so Combustion and Noxia pay off on L.I.N.X and Data Burst chains, then Caustica cracks magical-armor stackers.

items.Combustion: First: mana and area damage on top of Erase Vector's empowered Jolt.
items.Noxia: Second: hit with L.I.N.X, follow with Data Burst for bonus max-health damage.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: cuts healing and adds damage per ability hit on heroes.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fourth: penetration and bonus ability damage for every Overclocked cast.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fifth: multiplies power behind Final Thread's missing-health bomb.
items.Caustica: Last: ignores magical armor once enemies buy defense.

optimizer.holes: Neon must dash into range with Erase Vector to get value, and only Tainted Scepter adds any health if that dash gets punished.

optimizer.synergy: Phase heals herself and her linked ally after every cast, so Raiment's haste and Warp Stream's mana keep casts flowing while armor lets her survive beside her carry.

items.Warp Stream: First: mana for spamming casts that trigger Essence Catalyst heals.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Second: haste for more passive heals, plus missing-health regen.
items.Stonewall: Third: physical armor against the enemy carry focusing you and your link.
items.Vainglory: Fourth: both armors, growing while you stay in the fight.
items.Catalytic Drive: Fifth: magical armor and a self-heal on your basic-attack execute.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: tenacity so stuns don't cut your Energy Lance channel short.

optimizer.holes: Warp Stream replaces her Blink with Tele-Blink, which throws away Essence Catalyst's cheaper Blink and its damage boost on use.

optimizer.synergy: Inquisition's wave speeds early camps, Mutilator and Earthshaker reward chaining Pounce, Boulder Throw and Rumble, then penetration lets Behemoth's faster Rumble hit through armor.

items.Inquisition: First: extra monster damage and magical armor for a safer clear.
items.Mutilator: Second: max-health damage on Pounce, Boulder Throw and Rumble, plus healing.
items.Earthshaker: Third: melee builds stacks fast, boosting every ability in a gank.
items.The Perforator: Fourth: ignores armor and slows, keeping Rumble targets close.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Fifth: faster Behemoth and a damage boost for fights.
items.Basilisk: Last: armor shred and health for longer Behemoth brawls.

optimizer.holes: Rampage has to stand in fights during Behemoth, and with no physical armor in six items a focusing carry melts that bonus health.

optimizer.synergy: Essence grows every Renna ability, and haste items cycle Soulfire, Mortal Coil and Stupor faster to farm it, while Noxia and Magnify amplify the chained hits.

items.Orion: First: haste and attack speed for faster Vow pokes and casts.
items.Noxia: Second: land Stupor, then Mortal Coil for bonus max-health damage.
items.Magnify: Third: magical armor shred and healing on top of Mortal Coil's self-heal.
items.Tainted Scepter: Fourth: cuts enemy healing and adds damage on every ability hit.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration and bonus ability damage for Abyssal Rift.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power once Essence has scaled your abilities.

optimizer.holes: Abyssal Rift teleports Renna into the fight with no armor, so a team with stuns kills her before the singularity finishes.

metaBuilds.synergy: The final Hand Cannon round always crits, so stacking crit chance with Vanquisher, Terminus and Imperator also feeds Bounty Hunter's power and makes every reload hit harder.

items.Vanquisher: First: crit chance and an execute to finish Reckoning targets.
items.Terminus: Second: lifesteal, with overflow healing turned into a shield in duels.
items.Imperator: Third: bigger crits on every guaranteed final round.

metaBuilds.holes: This core skips attack speed, which Bounty Hunter also turns into power, so faster-attacking carries outtrade Revenant early.

optimizer.synergy: Bounty Hunter turns both crit chance and bonus attack speed into power, so Plasma Blade and Deathstalker feed it early while Imperator boosts the guaranteed final-round crit.

items.Plasma Blade: First: crit and attack speed both feed Bounty Hunter's power.
items.Deathstalker: Second: armor shred and attack speed for faster Hand Cannon cycles.
items.Viper: Third: more shred and on-hit damage, also lifting Obliterate.
items.Imperator: Fourth: bigger crits on the always-crit final round.
items.Manta Scythe: Fifth: lifesteal and bonus damage on lone targets pulled in by Reckoning.
items.Vanquisher: Last: crit plus an execute to close out low targets.

optimizer.holes: The execute and most crit arrive late, so this trails the field's Vanquisher-first crit core in early skirmishes.

optimizer.synergy: Riktor must walk in to land Riplash and Skewer, so physical armor first and tenacity later let him survive the engage while Electrocute's shield pulses.

items.Stonewall: First: physical armor to survive walking up for Riplash.
items.Forticus: Second: tenacity and a shield when you dive in with Skewer.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Third: big health and haste for more Riplash and Shock Therapy casts.
items.Transference: Fourth: turns leftover Electrocute shield into health, plus both armors.
items.Catalytic Drive: Fifth: magical armor and regen for long fights.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: tenacity and a burst of armor when focused.

optimizer.holes: Magical armor waits until the fourth item, so a mage-heavy team bursts Riktor before Skewer lands.

optimizer.synergy: Last Light converts bonus mana into power, so Resolution's mana stacks feed Scarlett first, and penetration makes Minueta's missing-health stabs and Swan Song finish through armor.

items.Resolution: First: on-hit damage and mana that Last Light turns into power.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows so Ashen Vow targets stay close.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Swan Song and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and speed while you chain abilities.
items.Mutilator: Fifth: max-health damage and healing across your ability chain.
items.Dread: Last: blocks magic burst while you sit Ablaze in fights.

optimizer.holes: Five damage items before any defense leave Scarlett relying on First Intent's shield, so a missed dash means she dies on landing.

optimizer.synergy: Chastise is Serath's alternate ability and applies on-hit to everything, so Alternator boosts it first, then penetration lets Heaven's Fury and Ascend dives cut through armor.

items.Alternator: First: Chastise is your alternate ability, so clears and ganks hit harder.
items.Mutilator: Second: max-health damage on Chastise, Heaven's Fury and Ascend, with healing.
items.The Perforator: Third: ignores armor and adds a slow to every dive.
items.Basilisk: Fourth: armor shred and health for longer Heresy fights.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Fifth: faster Heresy and a damage boost after casting.
items.Inquisition: Last: magical armor and a damage wave for late team fights.

optimizer.holes: Serath dives with Ascend and Heaven's Fury, and with almost no armor before the last slot she dies whenever no takedown resets Heresy.

optimizer.synergy: Haste from Orion and Timewarp means more Siphon casts to steal health and farm Souls, while magical power makes Subjugate and Colossal Blow hit like a mage offlaner.

items.Orion: First: haste and attack speed for more Siphon casts in lane.
items.Timewarp: Second: shorter Siphon and Subjugate cooldowns to farm Souls faster.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: cuts healing and adds health on top of Soul stacks.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: power and health for brawling inside Subjugate.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration and bonus damage for Colossal Blow.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power once Souls give you enough health.

optimizer.holes: Sevarog usually plays frontline; with no armor he relies on Soul health alone and dies fast once he falls behind on Souls.

optimizer.synergy: Siphon's bonus monster damage speeds clears, and haste from Orion and Timewarp cycles Siphon and Subjugate to steal health and stack Souls during ganks.

items.Orion: First: haste for faster Siphon casts on camps and ganks.
items.Timewarp: Second: mana regen and shorter cooldowns to keep clearing with abilities.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: cuts healing; takedowns from ganks fill its damage stacks.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: monster damage and jungle lifesteal for faster, healthier clears.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration for Colossal Blow's knockback engage.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power for Subjugate and Colossal Blow in team fights.

optimizer.holes: Spirit Of Amir's jungle bonus arrives fourth, long after clears matter most, and the build has no armor for contesting objectives.

optimizer.synergy: Every ability hit grants Track toward All-Kill!, so haste from Orion and Timewarp cycles Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and Circle Rhythm faster to unlock the ultimate sooner.

items.Orion: First: haste and attack speed for Biting Melody attacks between casts.
items.Timewarp: Second: shorter cooldowns build Track stacks faster for All-Kill!.
items.Tainted Scepter: Third: cuts healing and adds damage per ability hit.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: power and health for dashing in with Rushing Beat.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration and bonus damage for each All-Kill! wolf.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power behind Line Tempo and the wolf pack.

optimizer.holes: Shinbi dashes in with only Circle Rhythm's shield; against a bruiser offlaner she loses long trades with no armor.

optimizer.synergy: Hypercharge converts bonus attack speed into on-hit damage, so Viper and Deathstalker attack speed and on-hit boosts become Hypercharge damage before the crit items finish.

items.Viper: First: on-hit damage boost and armor shred that Hypercharge stacks fast.
items.Deathstalker: Second: attack speed Hypercharge converts into damage, plus more shred.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: wave clear, lifesteal and bonus damage on lone targets.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: first crit item and an execute after Atomiser.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits for normal Starfire attacks outside Hypercharge.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: attack speed for Hypercharge and stacking crit for long fights.

optimizer.holes: Hypercharge fires at a fixed rate and applies on-hit effects at reduced strength, so much of this on-hit build is muted while it runs.

optimizer.synergy: Relentless stacks on every basic attack, so Deathstalker and Viper attack speed and shred build stacks fast for Piercing Shot, then crit items power Inner Fire's arrows.

items.Deathstalker: First: attack speed to stack Relentless quickly, plus armor shred.
items.Viper: Second: on-hit and ability damage boost for Piercing Shot.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: wave clear, lifesteal and bonus damage on isolated targets.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: first crit item and an execute on low targets.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits, which Inner Fire's arrows can also land.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: attack speed and stacking crit for long Heightened Senses fights.

optimizer.holes: Sparrow has no dash, and six damage items with only Manta Scythe's lifesteal leave her dead to any dive.

optimizer.synergy: Steel's abilities scale off magical power and Cybernetic Shell scales with max health, so health-carrying mage items like Spectral Schematics and Magnify grow both his damage and shield.

items.Orion: First: haste for more Shield Bash and Bull Rush casts.
items.Spectral Schematics: Second: health for a bigger passive shield and bonus damage per hit.
items.Magnify: Third: magical armor shred, health and healing for long brawls.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: more power and health outside the jungle.
items.Wraith Leggings: Fifth: penetration and bonus damage for Shield Slam.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power behind Shield Slam and Bull Rush.

optimizer.holes: Cybernetic Shell converts bonus armor into the other armor, but this build buys none, so that half of his passive does nothing.

optimizer.synergy: Cybernetic Shell turns each bonus armor into extra of the other and scales with max health, so this health-and-armor stack makes Steel a wall that keeps engaging with Shield Slam.

items.Warp Stream: First: health, mana and Tele-Blink to set up Bull Rush angles.
items.Stonewall: Second: physical armor that his passive also turns into magical armor.
items.Vainglory: Third: both armors growing mid-fight, each feeding the other through his passive.
items.Raiment of Renewal: Fourth: big health for a bigger passive shield, plus haste.
items.Catalytic Drive: Fifth: magical armor, regen and gold from your basic-attack execute.
items.Unbroken Will: Last: tenacity and an armor burst when the enemy focuses you.

optimizer.holes: The haste is spread thin, so Shield Slam and Bull Rush come back slowly and Steel soaks damage without threatening anyone.

optimizer.synergy: Every basic attack builds Hersir, so Viper and Deathstalker attack speed empowers her next ability faster, and Viper's ability-damage boost also lifts Ruthless Assault and Highland Hurl.

items.Viper: First: on-hit and ability damage plus shred stacking with Highland Hurl.
items.Deathstalker: Second: attack speed to build Hersir stacks between casts.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: lifesteal and wave clear for holding the side lane.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: first crit item and an execute on fleeing targets.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits on Skullsplitter basic attacks.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: attack speed and stacking crit for long fights.

optimizer.holes: Terra's kit is built to dive and absorb hits; a no-defense crit build wastes Unstoppable Force's armor and leaves her dead after Wild Rush.

optimizer.synergy: Crit items lean on Skullsplitter basic attacks, which build Hersir stacks for an empowered Ruthless Assault, while Manta Scythe speeds camp clears.

items.Viper: First: armor shred and on-hit damage for faster camp clears.
items.Deathstalker: Second: attack speed builds Hersir fast on camps and ganks.
items.Manta Scythe: Third: bonus damage to small monsters and lifesteal to keep clearing.
items.Vanquisher: Fourth: crit chance and an execute for ganks that end low.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Plasma Blade: Last: attack speed and stacking crit for long objective fights.

optimizer.holes: A jungler diving with Wild Rush must live through the enemy team; with no armor or health here, Terra melts at objectives.

optimizer.synergy: The Fey's damage is all abilities, so Combustion and Wraith Leggings boost Untamed Growth and Harvest Nettles, while Timewarp keeps Bramble Patch and Nettles stacks cycling.

items.Combustion: First: mana and area damage for poking waves with Untamed Growth.
items.Wraith Leggings: Second: penetration and bonus damage on every ability.
items.Timewarp: Third: shorter cooldowns to keep Harvest Nettles stacks up.
items.Orion: Fourth: haste and growing damage on one target you keep hitting.
items.Oblivion Crown: Fifth: multiplies power behind Fly Trap's pull.
items.Caustica: Last: ignores magical armor once enemies buy defense.

optimizer.holes: The Fey has no dash, so a pure damage build leaves her dead to any assassin that gets past Bramble Patch.

optimizer.synergy: Gunslinger triple-shots and Vaporize apply on-hit effects repeatedly, so Sky Splitter's current-health damage and Viper shred stack fast while every hit shortens Rocket Dash.

items.Sky Splitter: First: current-health damage on every shot, strong against tanks.
items.Viper: Second: on-hit boost and shred that Vaporize applies at extra strength.
items.Deathstalker: Third: attack speed and more shred, also speeding Ventilate.
items.Plasma Blade: Fourth: crit chance for Ventilate bullets plus attack speed.
items.Imperator: Fifth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Tainted Rounds: Last: cuts healing; damage grows as the target gets low.

optimizer.holes: Crit starts on the fourth item and Sky Splitter is weaker on ranged heroes, so TwinBlast's opener underdelivers early.

optimizer.synergy: Hemophagia strikes faster with attack speed, so Orion turns haste into attack speed, while Tainted Scepter and Magnify add damage and healing to Arterial Grip and Exsanguinate.

items.Orion: First: haste becomes attack speed for faster Hemophagia strikes.
items.Tainted Scepter: Second: cuts healing and adds damage on every ability hit.
items.Wraith Leggings: Third: penetration and bonus damage for Arterial Grip and Bloodbound.
items.Magnify: Fourth: magical armor shred plus healing on top of Exsanguinate.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fifth: power and some health while channeling Arterial Grip.
items.Oblivion Crown: Last: multiplies power behind Lilith's strikes and Exsanguinate.

optimizer.holes: Arterial Grip breaks the moment Valmont is crowd-controlled, and this build has no tenacity or armor to stop that.

optimizer.synergy: Surprise, Surprise!'s passive penetration stacks with Deathstalker and Viper shred, so Knock, Knock! and basic attacks hit hard, and Necrosis shortens Back It Up! for picks.

items.Deathstalker: First: attack speed and armor shred on top of your passive penetration.
items.Viper: Second: on-hit and ability damage boost for Knock, Knock!
items.Plasma Blade: Third: crit chance and attack speed for sustained trades.
items.Imperator: Fourth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Vanquisher: Fifth: executes low targets that Back It Up! drags back.
items.Necrosis: Last: shorter Back It Up! cooldown for more picks.

optimizer.holes: Necrosis boosts ultimate damage, but Back It Up! is a teleport, so half of the last item does nothing for Wraith.

optimizer.synergy: Peekaboo! marks targets so Knock, Knock! hits for bonus damage with a shorter cooldown, and Viper's ability-damage boost plus shred make that poke combo hurt from range.

items.Deathstalker: First: armor shred stacking with your passive penetration for mid trades.
items.Viper: Second: boosts Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! damage on marked targets.
items.Plasma Blade: Third: crit and attack speed for basic attacks between pokes.
items.Imperator: Fourth: bigger crits once crit chance is stacked.
items.Vanquisher: Fifth: executes targets poked low by Knock, Knock!
items.Necrosis: Last: shorter Back It Up! cooldown for repeat picks.

optimizer.holes: Knock, Knock!'s marked bonus scales with magical power, which this build barely has outside Plasma Blade.

items.The Perforator: First: ignores armor and slows so High Impact slams land.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Second: faster stance swaps and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Third: stacking penetration and speed while you chain abilities.
items.Basilisk: Fourth: armor shred and health for long fights with clones.
items.Alternator: Fifth: boosts Windsurge/Force Push, your alternate ability.
items.Mutilator: Last: max-health damage and healing across your ability chain.

optimizer.holes: With no attack speed and little health, Wukong spawns clones slowly and loses extended fights against bruisers.

optimizer.synergy: Yin's damage comes from Windburn's third-hit max-health strike and Lash Kick, so Mutilator adds max-health damage and healing first, then penetration lets her extended whip shred.

items.Mutilator: First: max-health damage and healing for clearing camps early.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows to keep targets in whip range.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Quelling Gale and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and speed while chaining Lash Kick.
items.Basilisk: Fifth: armor shred from many whip hits, plus health.
items.Alternator: Last: boosts Backlash, your alternate ability, against grouped enemies.

optimizer.holes: Rising Storm wants attack speed, and this lethality build gives none, so Windburn's third hit comes slowly in duels.

optimizer.synergy: Whispering Echoes applies Soul Rip that resets Severance, so Alternator boosts that opener first, and haste keeps the Echoes, Severance, Anima Burst loop cycling.

items.Alternator: First: Whispering Echoes is your alternate ability, so it hits harder.
items.Basilisk: Second: armor shred from bouncing basic attacks, plus health.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: faster Soulstorm and a damage boost after casting.
items.The Perforator: Fourth: ignores armor and slows so Severance dashes connect.
items.Mutilator: Fifth: max-health damage and healing on top of Anima Burst.
items.Painweaver: Last: stacking penetration and speed while chaining abilities.

optimizer.holes: Yurei rushes in with Severance, and with only Basilisk's health she dies once Soul Rip resets stop coming.

optimizer.synergy: Spear of Nyr is Zarus's alternate ability, so Alternator boosts his main poke first, then penetration and Gladiator stacks let Coliseum and the low-health spear finish kills.

items.Alternator: First: bigger Spear of Nyr pokes in lane.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows spear-hit targets.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: more Coliseum casts and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and speed while chasing.
items.Basilisk: Fifth: armor shred and health for longer brawls.
items.Mutilator: Last: max-health damage and healing during long Coliseum fights.

optimizer.holes: Zarus leaps into Coliseum with no armor, and once Barricade is used he has nothing left to block burst.

optimizer.synergy: Alternator boosts Spear of Nyr for camps and gank pokes, and Earthshaker's melee stacks build quickly from basic attacks to boost Barricade swings and Coliseum.

items.Alternator: First: harder Spear of Nyr for clears and gank openers.
items.The Perforator: Second: ignores armor and slows targets before Coliseum.
items.Spear Of Desolation: Third: more Coliseum casts and a damage boost after casting.
items.Painweaver: Fourth: stacking penetration and speed for chasing between lanes.
items.Earthshaker: Fifth: melee builds stacks fast, boosting Barricade swings and spear damage.
items.Basilisk: Last: armor shred and health for objective fights.

optimizer.holes: Spear of Nyr deals reduced damage to monsters, so an Alternator start speeds clears less than it looks.

optimizer.synergy: Refibrillator's damage over time and Ricochet bounces charge Lifecore and Lunaria fast, and their heal power stacks with Infuse and Triage Protocol's boosted healing.

items.Lifecore: First: basic-attack damage charges wisps; heal power boosts Infuse.
items.Lunaria: Second: more heal power and stored damage that heals the weakest ally.
items.Oblivion Crown: Third: multiplies power behind Infuse and the Neural Regenesis revive.
items.Spirit Of Amir: Fourth: power and some health for staying in Infuse range.
items.Timewarp: Fifth: shorter Infuse and Ricochet cooldowns plus mana regen.
items.Windcaller: Last: shares speed with allies for chases and escapes.

optimizer.holes: Zinx has no escape, and with no defensive items a single dive on her stops the healing.
